rationale: Plan addresses all T11 objectives: claim volume and status distribution via claim_volume (with figure=true for status chart), denial rate using adjudicated_claims denominator (per T2 feedback to exclude pending claims that understate rate), fraud prevalence over all claims, and financial distributions with quantiles (sum_mean_quantiles per T2 feedback for skewed amounts). Monthly trends keyed on service_date_from (per T2 feedback to avoid adjudication lag). Report includes synthetic_data caveat and full artifact citations for reproducibility and statistical discipline.
